tradeoffs: Four native procurement priorities share finite mass reserves; no offensive weapon targets or XL reservations.
Target mass is a soft objective. Maximum base mass, if supplied, is enforced against an estimate including unresolved frame/support.
Endurance subdivisions/redundancy and maneuver performance are future policy only; no fabricated internal systems.
Core navigation/control housings and attached propulsion are preserved; player combat sensors are not automatically fitted.
Armor mass competition: nominal thickness scaled by 0.181894 against conservative exposed-area/density upper bound; no budget value overwritten.

Actual coverage is fixed by surviving finite surfaces; policy target is recorded as saturated by retained geometry. Physical coverage ratios are exposed-skin area retention, not an omnidirectional ship protection percentage.
